watch.en: Set the custard in a water bath, leave the bath uncovered, and take the custard out while the middle still wobbles a little.
watch.de: Die Creme im Wasserbad garen, das Bad offen lassen und die Creme herausnehmen, solange die Mitte noch leicht wackelt.

why.en: The edges then cook at the same pace as the middle, which gives a smooth finish. An open bath stays below the boil, and the heat left in the custard finishes the middle.
why.de: So garen die Ränder im gleichen Tempo wie die Mitte, und die Creme wird glatt. Ein offenes Bad bleibt unter dem Siedepunkt, und die Restwärme der Creme gart die Mitte fertig.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The outside edges cook evenly with the middle of the custard.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Even cooking is need to produce a smooth finish once cooked.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Eggs, Custard Theory and Practice - Cooking, p. 95
sources.sentence: It’s a mistake to cover the whole water bath, since this forces the water to the boil

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Eggs, Custard Theory and Practice - Cooking, p. 95
sources.sentence: Unless the custard needs to be firm enough to unmold, it’s best taken from the oven while the center is still slightly underdone and jiggly.

sources.place: In der Küche arbeiten: Speisen zubereiten - 2 Garen von Lebensmitteln, Garziehen/Pochieren, p. 268
sources.sentence: Eierstich wird indirekt pochiert, damit sich keine Bläschen darin bilden, was beim Kochen der Fall wäre.
